title: Intent lock: the owner's keywords are never forgotten
desc: T1 core. The PreToolUse intent lock pauses real work after an owner message (and after every compaction) until a skill search and the skills read cover 70 percent of his keywords. Named in every [intent-lock] refusal. Spec, success measure and the road that clears it (owner 2026-10-15).
steps: DECISION: the intent lock pauses the first real tool call after an owner message until his words have found their skills, read-only MCP calls such as get_session included; only a real prompt is owner text, never a Skill-tool skill body, an isMeta row or a bracketed harness notice (2026-11-12, owner found it; JS fixed in kih f1be9d1 (PR 152, gather.harness-notice.selftest.js 12/12), ps1 twin still open; a seat that reads skills through Bash wkappbot skill read has 0 such rows, measured on the spokesman transcript) (ROAD 2026-11-08: when the owner resends a batch you already answered piece by piece, run one fresh search of five chains first and name in the reply when each piece was already relayed (2026-11-12: the first-stop auto-update order came back at 11:07 because the 10:58 report never said it had gone to root 2 at 10:41 and 10:45), then check origin/main for the commit that already did it and report that hash instead of rebuilding (2026-11-09: a resent allow-list order was already merged as 7ddd92d), then check the roots; a status probe such as codex login status is refused the same way until that search passes; a resent batch whose items are all already dispatched gets that one search, one status probe per owning root, and a status reply, never a second dispatch of the same order) (road that works 2026-11-07: a notification-borne order such as the kih harness queue clears with ONE search of ORIGINAL=CORRECTED=english slots per Korean word, then one bare skill read per mandatory skill, never piped, because a pipe on a skill read trips the knowledge-op guard) (and when an owner sentence lands in a session whose repo does not own it, answer his question briefly in that session and relay only the execution: 2026-11-02 the landscape-proposal question reached the kih WebVM root, which gave the opinion and handed the PDF work to the spokesman). WHEN: an [intent-lock] refusal arrives, or a new owner message with 2+ Korean words, or the first call after a compaction (ROAD 2026-11-03: a joking owner idea with a trailing laugh mark still gets the full chain search first, and the idea itself becomes a ledger line the same turn, e.g. the issue-write-only signaling token became phase 1B). HOW: translate his key Korean words into 3+ English words and run wkappbot skill search WORD1 WORD2 WORD3, read the governing skill it finds with wkappbot skill read ID, and when his words are missing from its tags add them with wkappbot skill edit ID --tags, run from inside the repo that holds the skill fork (ROAD 2026-11-09: from /home/user the lock saw no existing tags and refused all of them as new; a lone cd into wkappbot-kih first passed at once) (copy the existing tag line first, --tags replaces it; there is no --add-tags flag, so paste the old line plus the new chains in one --tags call); skill search, read and edit are never locked, so the lock is always satisfiable. ROAD for a resent order: read the top hits, tag the governing skill with the corrected chains (2026-11-12: harness-installer-owns-all-setup took the five first-stop refresh chains), then say in the reply when each piece was already relayed. AN UNJUST REFUSAL IS THE LOCK'S BUG, NOT THE READER'S FAULT (owner 2026-10-16: an unjust block is a bug, heal the reflex so no intelligence turns rebellious): when a missing word cannot honestly be tagged (a pronoun such as 얘는, a word glued to a particle such as 오퍼스인데, an interjection), say so in one line of the reply, add only honest tags, and keep working; never fake a tag and never resend the same call to burn the 3-refusal release, and a release after 3 refusals is itself a bug (owner 2026-10-16: delete the cap code), so no count ever releases the lock: the only exit is the honest road the refusal prints, and resending the same call is ignoring the guidance (owner 2026-10-16, to a new Opus spokesman that resent one Agent dispatch three times: this rookie ignores the guidance and charges); when honest tags still read as missing, find out why (particle suffix, filler word, the tag edit not reaching the scanned skill roots) before the next call; ROAD for a follow-up owner line that refines an order already sent: fold it into the same open PR order instead of a second PR (2026-11-04 tier map into the owner-login PR); road that works (2026-10-16): when the missing required keywords are wrapper words such as command, haiku or name that no skill can honestly carry, run ONE pair search, name the lock's bug in one line, and stop dispatching instead of repeating the call (a spokesman burned six dispatches and filled its session with search lists). TODO (measured 2026-10-16, seat 9387fef4): (a) slash-command echo rows (command-name, command-message, command-args, local-command-stdout of /clear and /model) are read as owner rows, so command, message, args, name, model, stdout and local became REQUIRED keywords and filled 8 of the 12 rule-1 slots, a ring no honest search clears; exclude those tags in the owner-row filter of Test-WkOwnerKeywordSearch.ps1 line 209; (b) the search capture counts option tokens such as --keep as search words; peel options and read past leading global options (wkappbot --keep X skill search WORDS); a refused bare skill search is the lock refusing its own remedy (still open 2026-11-12 17:00: a haiku sector was refused on a plain npm view after four searches; kih ROOT 3 builds the RED from that live transcript; cause: the sector wrote wkappbot=wkappbot and core.js refused a second slot equal to the word, though a product name has no synonym; PR 177 lets a wk-prefixed or digit-bearing word repeat itself, sector-identity.selftest 4/4), fixed in place by the root it blocks (2026-11-12: kih ROOT 3 was refused on every Bash call, the launch brief counted as owner sentences: a sliding 16-word window over the whole 2000-char brief, not a growing list; fixed in kih PR 174 by gather.js boundLaunchBrief, judging a long brief-shaped first row on its first sentence, gather.launch-brief.selftest.js RED 3/6 to GREEN 6/6); (c) the Claude entry wkharness.ps1 never calls Invoke-WkEmergencyEditEarly and its Block never stamps the repair list, while the codex main does both, so a Claude session can never repair a refusing guard (owner 2026-10-16: the emergency door runs before the on-load lock, that is the standard). WHY: owner 2026-10-15, design intent: the intelligence never forgets the keywords the owner said, across turns and across compactions; every Korean tag added is a gift that lets the next intelligence find the governing skill at once (dae-dae-son-son hongik). //why:reading more printed skills raised coverage past the threshold //why:pages and study lock questions resent while the earlier turn still ran-unknown //why:pipes in a search command hide it from the exemption-unknown //why:reading more printed skills raised coverage past the threshold-unknown //why:confirmed road works after hotfix landed //why:search first then read clears it //why:search then read then like clears it //why:search first then read then like //why:pause clears after search and read //why:search and read clear the pause //why:search read like clears the pause

DECISION (owner 2026-11-13: split queued intent by topic and drain it with several searches; the cumulative-coverage port is ordered to kih ROOT 6 for 0.3.36, until it lands a single line must still reach 77 percent of its own message; measured 2026-11-13 on the PC hub, two queued sentences cleared by two topic searches with no refusal, so the refusal bites only when one message mixes topics and one line misses 77 percent): clear an [intent-lock] refusal with ONE search built from the refusal itself (2026-11-02: an owner line meant for another root reached the kih WebVM root; one filled retry line cleared it, then the root stopped its landscape-export sector because the owner said that job was not its). WHEN: any [intent-lock] refusal. HOW: run wkappbot skill read intent-lock, then write ONE search in this order: first every word the refusal lists as required, plain and in its order (ROAD 2026-11-02: an owner line repeated after an earlier pass re-locks with the OLD chains plus the new ones (2026-11-09: a resend of twelve earlier orders passed with ONE search of 46 chains built from the earlier filled ones; the lock refused only one corrected slot that kept its particle, 설정과-최신으로 to 설정-최신), so reuse the earlier filled chains verbatim and append the new ones, as the refusal retry line itself does); then the nouns of the owner's last message as owner-word=english pairs; keep the total token count inside the band the refusal prints (need A to B); for each listed word no read skill carries, add it as a t- tag on intent-lock (ROAD 2026-11-03 owner panel design: the portal intent panel shows one button per chain by its third slot, greys to green as skills cover it, and gathers uncovered words in one leftmost bucket; find a dashboard by its owning repo first, e.g. SPOKESMAN.md named the portal panel PRs 26-29 in ***-***) (step on temporary tags) and re-read intent-lock; put any option before the subcommand, as in wkappbot --keep X skill search WORDS. When the owner message holds a long paste, first pull it verbatim from the session transcript (grep the jsonl for its first words; a short reply such as a URL request still owes chains for the previous owner message, since the lock also scores the newest-but-one turn: 2026-10-31 a 4-chain search scored 38 percent) and build every adjacent-word chain from that text in one search, giving each chain a corrected slot that differs from the original and dropping chains the refusal marks as used twice (2026-10-29: a 40-line meeting notice passed at 96 percent this way after five partial rounds). When the required words alone outnumber the band's upper bound, the lock is in a ring: name it in one line, keep healing reflexes with skill edits (never locked) and wait for the owner's next message, whose length widens the band; the same holds when a stop frame reads a stale local letter after the real one landed on main: answer once, briefly, and wait (example 2026-11-07 kih ROOT K: a haiku hand-back text re-locked Bash as if it were owner words because the installed lite hook predates the relay rows; the road was one skill read of this skill, one like, then the pending Bash call passed; and 2026-10-29: the letter was on main at 61dbca0 while the session branch still held the old one). WHY: 2026-10-16 the spokesman cleared the lock in one call with 8 required words plus 4 pairs once those words carried t- tags, after trailing --keep and a 13-token search had each been refused. //why:farewell turn searched once per queued sentence group //why:branch reflex order cleared before measuring skill drift to main-unknown //why:monster ten chain line refused, ordered cumulative drain-unknown //why:farewell turn searched once per queued sentence group-unknown

DECISION: a search token that finds no fitting skill gets a TEMPORARY TAG on this intent-lock skill to pass the lock (ROAD 2026-11-08: a worker restart notice was counted as owner words and refused every Bash call of the aiportal-demo ROOT; that ROOT tags this skill itself with its full tag list plus chains from the notice tokens, no approval needed, since RULE ONE pre-approves the fix), and those temporary tags are healed periodically. WHEN: the lock lists a required or owner keyword that no governing skill carries. HOW: run wkappbot skill read intent-lock, copy its tag line, append the missing words each prefixed with t- (owner 2026-10-16: temporary tags carry a t- prefix so a heal pass finds them by grep, and the lock still matches them by substring; example t-command), run wkappbot skill edit intent-lock --tags with the whole line, re-read it and rerun the standard-intent-token search. ROAD 2026-11-11 (kih spokesman): the classifier refused a --tags edit on on-load until the owner typed his approval; after it the same --tags line released the lock at once and git status ran. ROAD: run the tag edit from inside the repo that holds the skill; from another working directory (2026-11-09: /home/user) the lock could not see the skill's current tags and refused every existing tag as new. ROAD for a bare number word: glue the owner word that precedes it onto it, and give the same-language slot a new phrase rather than the old one minus its modifier (2026-11-04 burst-poll order passed on the second search); at each heal pass (descent or the nightly heal) move each temporary tag to the skill that truly governs the word or delete it, above all the tags a since-fixed lock bug forced. WHY: owner 2026-10-16: register temporary tags on the intent-lock skill to break through a token with no fitting skill, and heal the added tags periodically; the same day the tags command, message, args, name, model, stdout, local and clear cleared a ring caused by slash-command echo rows. (and in a demo the hold is shown with the threshold set only for that scene and reset after, e.g. 2026-11-02 the portal QA video fipy hold) //why:reflex history words tagged onto hippo memory skill //why:restart notice counted as owner words blocked root-unknown //why:skills folder reproduction needed four plan lines before the stop-unknown //why:reflex history words tagged onto hippo memory skill-unknown //why:classifier refused tag edit so impressions tokens stayed uncovered all turn //why:root module 5915e53 now frees family skill reads while the lock waits //why:duplicate farewell delivery cleared by one corrected chain line

DECISION: a modifier phrase may stay one sharp keyword, joined by hyphens on both sides (ROAD 2026-11-08: the reply quotes the CORRECTED or STRENGTHENED slot of each chain, never the raw typo slot, because the owner types on a phone; the stop coverage accepts any slot), and a tag may be written the same way (ROAD 2026-11-03: when the lock refuses a bare verb chain, prefix the owner word that precedes it, e.g. 작전-짜시오 and 레포에서-관리되게하삼 passed at 100 percent). WHEN: the owner's key noun carries adjectives or adverbs (example: the Korean for very-smart-opus written as three hyphen-joined Korean words, paired with very-smart-opus). HOW: run wkappbot skill read intent-lock, then write the pair hyphen-joined in his word order; the release test splits the Korean side on hyphens and counts the pair when every piece is in the owner text (substring or one edit away), and splits the English side the same way, counting it when the whole phrase or every piece is a tag of the read skills; a hyphen-joined Korean tag counts when every piece occurs in the owner text. WHY: owner 2026-10-16: describe the modifying words with hyphens, Korean included, register tags the same way, so sharply described keywords become possible and a modifier never turns into a missing keyword. //why:owner phone message on pretooluse family store conversion answered with chain slots //why:six chain warnings stayed after the plan line named them-unknown //why:rename order chains passed with hyphen joined corrected slots-unknown ROAD 2026-11-12 spokesman: the owner resent two orders merged into one prompt after both were already relayed; one five-chain search cleared the lock, and the answer named the orders already sent to root 2 instead of dispatching them again. //why:reinstall order chains used owner word modifiers like 루트들에게-재설치 to pass //why:four owner messages answered in one combined reply

DECISION (owner 2026-10-31, PLAN SENTENCE IS THE SECOND KEY): token coverage alone must NOT open the lock. After the search passes and the skills are read, the lock WARNS, never blocks (ROAD 2026-11-03: a ROOT-report turn carries no owner words, and neither does a relayed peer message or a subagent hand-back (road that works: when the lock counts such text as owner words, add its prefix to RELAY_RX in tools/wkjs/guards/pre/intent-lock/gather.js and core.js and tools/wkjs/guards/stop/intent-lock.js, example 2026-11-07: [MESSAGE FROM NON-USER SOURCE and Another Claude session sent a message), so pay the named like first and the turn proceeds) (owner 2026-11-01: make the plan block a warning; the line reaches the model as PreToolUse additionalContext through .claude/hooks/wkharness-run.sh) until the session STATES ITS EXECUTION PLAN: one sentence per intent chain, each quoting that chain intent-strengthening slot (the third slot) VERBATIM and naming on the same line what will be done for it -- a file, a command, or skip plus the reason. Every chain needs its sentence; one missing chain keeps the lock closed. WHY: a session can cover 100 percent of his words and still act on something else, so the plan sentence is what proves the words were understood, and no tag or read can fake it. DECISION: every tool call after an owner message is blocked until a skill search written as standard intent tokens (original=corrected=synonym=english chains, several per search) has run since that message (owner 2026-10-16: if no standard-intent-token skill search follows the user words, block everything; a plain-words search does not count, and right after an owner message the wkappbot skill search command itself is refused as an anti-knowledge pattern when its arguments hold no original=corrected=synonym=english chain (owner 2026-10-16: the refusal text prints one example chain); example: the plain query for the owner-anger skill ranked it last while the chained query ranked it fourth). A skill search that drops a required keyword is refused, and the refusal lists the missing required keywords in the order the owner first said them, to be put IN FRONT of the search. WHEN: the owner said a keyword two or more times in the session (a required keyword) and the newest search lacks it as a Korean left side or as its English right side. HOW: run wkappbot skill read intent-lock, then rerun the search with the missing required keywords first, in order of first appearance, each as a KOREAN=english pair, followed by the last message's pairs (example shape: the intent-lock pair first, then the required-keyword pair, then the skill-search pair). WHY: owner 2026-10-16: block when a required keyword is missing from the skill search and have it put in front in the order it appeared, so the sharp required keywords survive every compaction. //why:owner asked about unlocked source guidance; plan lines owed //why:plan lines named each third slot before the commit-unknown //why:eight-chain order needed one plan line per strengthened slot-unknown //why:owner asked about unlocked source guidance; plan lines owed-unknown

DECISION: a sector clears the lock with the ready search line its brief carries for its short English Goal line (2026-11-08: a create_session brief to the aiportal-demo ROOT carried no search line, the new root stopped at its first Bash and asked the spokesman to choose; one follow-up message with a four-chain English line unblocked it). ROAD 2026-11-08 kih spokesman: six haiku sectors passed with a brief that opens First calls, Goal, a First Bash line of hyphen chains with different words per slot, a 40+ char quote, and one Constraints sentence telling the sector to run the printed RETRY LINE with every placeholder filled when refused; each needed at most one retry. ROAD 2026-11-07 (kih ROOT N): a root whose search was refused as adds no new owner word -- missing: (none) cleared the lock with three slots per word, ORIGINAL=CORRECTED=english, where the last English word differs from the original (e.g. in-order=in-order=sequence); four-slot chains and chains repeating the original were the refused forms. ROAD 2026-11-07 (kih ROOT N): a sector brief that opens with a Goal line and a ready three-slot search line cleared the lock in 3 of 4 dispatches (ROAD 2026-11-12 kih spokesman: a seat already stuck on the old lock cannot fetch the fix; a fresh root that runs install.sh from main, or a seat that clones kih main and reruns install.sh --seat, gets the fixed lock) (ROAD 2026-11-11 kih spokesman: a Goal word left without a chain, where, refused the ready line; give every Goal word its own chain, e.g. from=out-of); the sector cut (gather.js sectorGoal and its two ps1 copies, Get-WkReflexLockState.ps1 and oracle/intent-lock.ps1) must change in all three places together, and a no-label first-line rule is wrong because the brief guard forces a First calls line first. ROAD (2026-11-05 kih appbot-code): three haiku briefs that omitted the filled search stalled after two retries with zero commands run, while a Read-and-Grep-only sector passed untouched; give a measuring sector Read and Grep work when its Goal cannot match the relayed owner words. ROAD (2026-11-05 kih appbot-code): three haiku briefs that omitted the filled search all stalled after two retries with zero commands run, while ROOT ran the same npm pack and selftest commands itself and got RESULT 21/21; a brief without that line is a dispatch that cannot start. WHEN: dispatching any sector. HOW: put the GOAL line and its filled search first in the brief, as intent-lock-howto step 1 shows. WHY: the 2026-11-01 F2F3 sector cleared it on its first call. OPEN: Get-WkIntentPendingState keeps only a passing query, so a failing sector search's Reason is dropped and the sector sees the generic RETRY LINE. //why:two opencode census haiku briefs carried ready WORD=SYNONYM search lines //why:root told to fan five items to haiku sectors each with a fully chained goal search //why:new CLI bulk install order arrived mid-fix-unknown //why:owner outage question cleared by governing skill tags-unknown //why:root told to fan five items to haiku sectors each with a fully chained goal search-unknown

DECISION: no word-count threshold decides whether an owner message is judged; and a numeric THRESHOLD for a gate (e.g. the portal intent-lock keyword-coverage percent) is an owner-spec constant the spokesman PROPOSES, never fixes unasked -- 2026-10-31 I put 25% in a brief on my own, which was wrong. WHEN: the host or the release test meets an owner message of one or two words. HOW: run wkappbot skill read intent-lock, then judge every owner message with at least one content word, Korean or English (ROAD 2026-11-11 kih 823a437: a sub-agent hand-back or task-notification that starts with a long system block is never an owner message, so gather.js skips a row carrying such a marker anywhere, not only in its first 400 characters); a short message borrows prior keywords in front instead of being skipped. WHY: owner 2026-10-16: the two-words-or-fewer skip (the old 2+ Hangul words trigger) is patch code and the seed of a big bug someday, so delete it; ordered into the v9 sector the same minute. (2026-11-02: the QA video hold scene for the spokesman plan that drops fipy) //why:stop coverage PR kept unmerged without a selftest run //why:replayed refused sectors passed lite lock in seven and twenty-four seconds //why:Qwen remark judged too, cleared after tagging the step text-unknown //why:root report turn carried no owner words yet the debt asked for one like-unknown //why:replayed refused sectors passed lite lock in seven and twenty-four seconds-unknown

DECISION: a pair may carry synonyms as a chain, owner-word=synonym=english (ROAD 2026-11-08: every chain must START with a word the owner typed; an extra chain such as ***-***-이름 was refused as not an owner word, and the retry line without it passed at once), and the chain still counts as ONE token (2026-11-01: a chain an accepted reply already covered must drop out of both the lock and the stop coverage; until that lands a one-line answer needed 120 chains, fix ordered to the kih harness root). WHEN: a keyword has a near-synonym the owner may say next time, or a tag should be found by two Korean words. HOW: run wkappbot skill read intent-lock, then write the chain left to right: the first side is the owner's (typo-corrected, hyphen-joined if modified) word and must be in the owner text, the middle sides are synonyms that need not be (any number of them, ten or more is fine, in ANY language; STANDARD INTENT TOKEN, Korean name 표준의도토큰 (owner 2026-10-16: the official term for this notation, call each chain a standard intent token): original=typo-corrected=synonym=english, where a slot that repeats an earlier spelling is skipped (a=a=b is just a=b, and an already-English owner word may stand alone), the checker splits on equals, drops duplicates case-insensitively, takes the first as the owner side and the last as the English tag side (the lock also stands down SILENTLY on four paths: WK_INTENT_LOCK=0, wkappbot off PATH, the V2 module unloaded, no wkhippo rows; so a session showing zero [intent-lock] refusals is unproven, not compliant -- 2026-10-24 the PC spokesman ran no chain search in 100 events); every slot may itself be a hyphen chain of several modifiers (ROAD 2026-11-03: a new tag while the lock is active must be a CORRECTED=ENGLISH pair copied from the passing search, e.g. 노란색이-반짝이면-어떤가=yellow-sparkle passed while invented pairs were refused) (owner 2026-10-16: each word takes many modifiers joined by hyphens; ROAD 2026-11-03: read the modifier before the noun as part of the meaning, e.g. 일분안에 신호 있었으면 means a signal seen within the last minute, not the first minute of the session, which the spokesman first misread; ROAD 2026-11-03: when the owner later resends his lines as one full message, re-read every condition word against what was relayed, e.g. 덜 바쁠때만 reversed the edit-mode rule and the correction went out the same minute), and the checker splits each slot on hyphens and counts a slot when every piece matches (ROAD 2026-11-03: when the owner resends a question already relayed, confirm it against the ledger and the howto spec instead of opening a new item, e.g. the plan-cited gloss question); the typo-corrected slot applies to EVERY language and drops particles too (2026-11-05 ROAD: 하네스의-특징은 is corrected as 하네스-특징, never the same words with the particle kept; a chain's original side must be owner words with their modifier, e.g. 더-앱봇코드, never a bare 앱봇코드 or an English piece like 앱봇코드-the; a lone Latin word takes the particle after it as its modifier, e.g. owner 'wk 가' becomes 가-wk=가-WK=두글자-약자=wk-acronym) (owner 2026-10-16: an English typo is fixed in the corrected slot too, and French or Spanish owner words follow the same principle), so the corrected spelling is just another middle slot of the standard intent token, Korean, English or other, owner 2026-10-16: similar words may be registered many times and are language-free), and the last side is English and must match a read-skill tag (whole or by hyphen pieces); register the synonyms as tags too so the next search finds the skill by either word. WHY: owner 2026-10-16: allow similar vocabulary to be registered twice, modified-word1=similar-word1=english-keyword1, so one meaning is found by every word that names it. //why:relayed restart notices need only short chains //why:patrol order chained three slots, cleared first try //why:name candidate chains all began with owner words //why:db runner connect question cleared with seven synonym chains in one search-unknown //why:resent Qwen and pro tier lines cleared by one seven chain search-unknown //why:name candidate chains all began with owner words-unknown

author: claude
